thread:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 429 rate observed for Dedicated control-plane APIs and some hosted endpoints in us-east. Customers reporting rate-limit errors. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1851234567

oncall-kim: I'm on it. beginning triage: checking quota-service, control-plane autoscaler, and any recent config changes. @sre-drew join?

sre-drew: joining. Seeing spike in quota-service latency >1s and retries. Many control-plane calls returning 429 from quota.

eng-quinn: noticed a recent config change to quota thresholds for dedicated-tenants at 04:30Z — it incorrectly applied a global policy override. Reverting now.

quota-bot: config-change detected: policy/global_override=true applied by config-operator at 04:29Z. Triggering rollback to previous policy.

sre-drew: rolling back policy -> applying hotfix to code path that gated per-tenant quotas. Patch deployed to quota-service instances; restarting service processes.

oncall-kim: temporarily increasing rate-limit buffer for dedicated-control-plane in us-east to avoid customer throttles: set global_buffer=30% for 15m.

support-lee: sending short customer notice: "We are investigating intermittent 429 (rate limit) errors for Dedicated control-plane in US-EAST. Mitigation in progress. More updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1851234567"

incidents-bot: MITIGATION: config rollback complete; quota-service replicas restarted; observed 429s drop from ~14% -> ~2% over 5 minutes.

eng-quinn: confirming: root cause = config-operator applying global override accidentally during a staging->prod promotion. Will add safe-checks to operator.

product-aria: contacting impacted customers. recommending 24-48h usage credit offers as appropriate. Please include list of affected orgs in postmortem.

sre-drew: leaving enhanced metrics collection on for 1h (quota latency, 429s by tenant). Collecting heap and thread dumps for quota-service.

oncall-kim: postmortem owners: @eng-quinn (config operator fix), @sre-drew (mitigation), @product-aria (customer comms). ETA for initial RCA draft: EOD today.

incidents-bot: STATE: resolved (mitigated). Public status updated. Next: RCA and timeline to follow. Thread limited to incident leads.
